title: David Sacks’s Pool Boy Is Cocky
content:
Kara Swisher, linking to a clip of Jason Calacanis almost getting kicked off a panel on MS NOW:

Jason Calacanis has been an unctuous toady and billionaire fellator for so long that it’s hard to imagine him being anything else.

Nilay Patel was on the same panel, and here’s a smart clip of him handing Calacanis his bootlicking hat. Calacanis’s central argument is — no exaggeration — that the fate not just of democracy but humanity itself rests on Jensen Huang remaining in charge at Nvidia. That’s an argument that is taken as gospel in the AI-pilled wing of X, but that looks absurd when made on national television in the face of reasoned pushback. How this guy doesn’t get punched in the face once or twice a week I don’t know.

 ★
author: John Gruber
